text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the nature of your pain—does it feel sharp, burning, or like an electric shock—and does it travel below your knee? I also need to know if you are experiencing any weakness in your leg or foot, or if you have had any loss of bladder or bowel control.

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any numbness or tingling in your foot or leg, and have you noticed any weakness when trying to lift your foot or stand on your toes? REQUEST TEST: MRI of the Lumbar Spine
